articles.title: Bullish, Alpaca and Apex Fintech form coalition to push issuer-backed tokenized stocks
articles.snippet: The group aims to link onchain shares to official shareholder records following the U.S. SEC's innovation exemption for tokenized stock trading.

articles.title: European stablecoin issuer Qivalis sees transformation of global trade finance
articles.snippet: Jan-Oliver Sell, the CEO and founder of Qivalis, said the entire trade finance supply chain is moving into stablecoins.

articles.title: Solana Foundation hires Binance, Polygon veterans as it ramps up tokenized finance push
articles.snippet: Rachel Conlan and Jamal Raees join as Solana aims to court institutions moving payments and assets onchain.

articles.title: EU's financial regulator to make AI and tokenization a supervisory priority in 2027
articles.snippet: European regulators will map how financial firms use the technologies in client-facing products and begin checks on the most affected businesses.

articles.title: Live updates: Oil back on the rise as Iran denies report of deal talks
articles.snippet: Bitcoin pulled back to $84,000 as stocks slipped and interest rates rose alongside surging oil prices.
